long_biography.plain_text:
Brooklyn-born Perry Weitz co-founded Weitz & Luxenberg in 1986 after beginning a career representing workers in complex civil litigation. He remains a co-founding member of the New York firm. The firm's legal practice, rather than the gross value of awards obtained for clients, is the clearest documented origin of his business wealth.

Weitz moved into real-estate investment and property development. He has developed and managed hospitality, residential and commercial properties, remains a partner in Oak Row Equities and joined Douglas Elliman's board. These interests broaden his present portfolio, but their relative personal value is undisclosed. Client settlements belong to clients, while development sites, financing and project values belong to the relevant entities and partners; none should be treated as his direct personal assets.
